summary: Cameroon’s restoration package targets 5,000,000 ha of reforestation (about 13.6% of current forest cover), 500,000 ha of assisted regeneration, 650,000 ha of degraded-land rehabilitation, 3,000 ha of agroforestry, 3,299,000 ha of forest enclosure/protection, and 500 ha of degraded-soil restoration. Conservation adds 1,000,000 ha of avoided deforestation, equivalent to about 2.7% of current forest, and 394.2 ha of forest plantations. Agriculture combines 230,000 ha of intermittent rice flooding and 1,000,000 ha under nitrification inhibitors—roughly 3.4% and 15.0% of current agricultural area—with 12,500 ha of forage plantations, 2,000 tonnes of compost/biofertilizer, 25 million plants annually, at least 15% sustainable use of developable and irrigable land, separate 5%-of-added-meal and 12%-of-added-DM-fat feed targets, and inhibitor use by 5% of farmers by 2030.
